question: Should the new owner-scoped session creation and delegated execution capabilities become supported Plugin SDK contracts for Codex supervision and other trusted harness delegates?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but accepting a new long-lived plugin API and trust surface requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the narrow contracts
options.body: Accept the owner-scoped APIs with the included invariant tests, documentation, and fail-closed checks.

options.title: Narrow to Codex-only internals
options.body: Refactor supervision behind a Codex-specific facade instead of adding general Plugin SDK capability.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause supervision until the permanent plugin session-ownership API is designed independently.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the owner-scoped APIs with the included invariant tests, documentation, and fail-closed checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked feature issue and merged history identify this person as the primary product and implementation owner for Codex supervision.
